Over the past 11 years, I've launched products from 0-to-1 and optimized them to scale across commerce, logistics, and AgTech—working with millions of users across global markets  I thrive in the intersection of multi-sided platform mechanics, applied AI/ML, and human incentive design—whether that’s tuning routing algorithms for last-mile logistics or orchestrating global open-source communities.  I specialize in the messy, interesting challenges of platform products: obsessively focusing on client and consumer needs, balancing stakeholder ecosystems, designing marketplace dynamics that work, and turning complex problems into solutions that work and make sense.

Having served as an official reporting manager across my last three roles, I lead with a focus on team cohesion, radical clarity, and career mentorship. I believe the best product leaders don't just write specs; they build high-trust, collaborative environments where teams can ship fast under real constraints.
Off the clock, I experiment with full-stack AI agents, build tools, and write about tech strategy, product judgment, and satire.
